Optional — Jobber note

One boat/job can include multiple codes. Finish a code, then use Add Another Code for one combined Jobber note. Permanent save = paste into Jobber. This phone only keeps the unfinished current job for Resume.

Items marked * are required. Answer them, or use Skip with a reason. Blank answers will not continue.

Jobber Note

Review the note for this job. Copy text into Jobber for the written note. Use Save HTML + photos for an evidence file (bold answers + step photos) you can attach to the Jobber job. Use Add Another Code for more alarms on the same boat.
No permanent archive is kept on the phone. Jobber is the record. Resume only restores the unfinished current job on this device/browser.
